dataset.title: SIRT7-induced PHF5A de-crotonylation regulates ageing progress through alternative splicing-mediated downregulation of CDK2

findings.message: 6 of the 6 channels of the search's TmtDesign.txt have no row of the SDRF naming their file and label, so their assays sit on the design's own sample (its `Sample Name`), with nothing known about it. E.g. `PXD027232:all_LC-MS:TMT126`, `PXD027232:all_LC-MS:TMT127`, `PXD027232:all_LC-MS:TMT128` and 3 more.
The search identified an unusually small fraction of the MS2 spectra. Treat absence of a protein in this dataset as weak evidence. Producer's note: 772/25730 = 3.00% of MS2 identified (S3)

no SDRF says which sample is in which channel (every SDRF was refused); PXReprise's default design makes each file its own plex and each channel that shows a sample its own sample; the reporter values compare nothing until a design is curated (QuantProject 079)
The deposited SDRF carries no biological annotation: organism part, cell type, disease and individual are all absent. Sample-level questions cannot be answered for this dataset until it is curated.

Some modifications on peptides shared between proteins were not written to ptm_sites for one or more of those proteins, because the peptide could not be located in that protein's sequence and the producer's residue spans cannot be paired with its accessions. Of the (PSM, protein) pairs affected: 5 named a protein that does not contain the stored peptide -- typically a PSM ambiguous between peptide sequences (level 4 or 5), where this protein carries a different candidate than the first, which is the one stored. Sites on the other proteins of the same PSMs are written. Counts are in bundle.json under protein_databases.

PTM site occupancy was not stored: this is a TMT dataset, and MetaMorpheus computes intensity occupancy for label-free searches only; its count occupancy is per file, repeated on every channel (QuantProject DEF-OCC-INT). `ptm_stoichiometry` has no rows here because of that, not because no site was modified.

No per-run `metrics` row from results.txt for `psms_1pct` (1 of 1 runs), `peptides` (1 of 1 runs), `protein_groups` (1 of 1 runs), `precursors` (1 of 1 runs), `ms2_scans` (1 of 1 runs). These counts were not written, which is not a count of zero. MetaMorpheus writes results.txt's per-file lines only for a search of two or more files, and this deposit has one run, so its deposit-wide rows (`scope = 'dataset'`) count that run. Each run's MS2 spectra are also counted by the QC report, in `runs.ms2_spectra` and `metrics` (`name = 'ms2'`, `source = 'qc_report.json'`), for 1 of the 1 runs. PXReprise's QC payload counts each run's share of the whole search's 1% set instead, a different number (the FDR is the whole search's, not recomputed on each file), under names of its own (`source = 'qc_payload.json'`): `psms_1pct_whole_search` for 1 of the 1 runs, `peptides_1pct_whole_search` for 1 of the 1 runs, `protein_groups_1pct_whole_search` for none of them.

dataset.summary: PXD027232 is a DDA isobaric dataset (Homo sapiens) with 1 run, 6 samples and enrichment: phospho. It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.14. At 1% FDR the search reports 772 PSMs and 371 protein groups; 580 peptidoforms pass 1% on its q-value and notch q-value, and the repository holds 1,425 PTM sites for it. 6 open warnings about it are recorded.

organisms_are: `organisms` is the organism of the protein DATABASE the search used, not a statement about the samples. Sample annotation, where any exists, is in the catalog's `samples` and `sample_characteristics` tables.
